jobs.title: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team and contribute to next‑generation power electronics. You will work on silicon carbide semiconductor reliability in a dynamic research environment. The role focuses on developing and improving innovative testing solutions for power devices. You collaborate closely with experts and gain insights into real research challenges. You will grow by combining experimental work with data analysis and system development. This position offers hands‑on access to advanced laboratories and close cooperation with industry and academia. How you'll make an impact Conduct measurement campaigns and analyze reliability data of SiC devices Develop and improve test setups for dynamic reliability testing Design solutions for advanced sensing and automated data collection Optimize power converter systems for long-term testing Upgrade measurement electronics and data acquisition systems Support integration of monitoring systems for device aging Document and communicate results within research and business teams Your background Currently enrolled in a Master's program in physics, electr onics   engineering , materials   engineering   or a related discipline (official enrolment is essential) Familiar with   electrical measurements setup   and with   the design and construction of electronics systems .   Previous   experience with semiconductor physics and\/or power devices is a strong plus Experience with LabView programming, and knowledge of programming languages ( e . g.   Python, C ,   Matlab ) Fluency in written and spoken English Good communication   and technical writing skills Creative and able to work autonomously More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Internship in Computational Chemistry 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months.    How you'll make an impact  Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization  Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages  Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team    Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods  Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage  Fluency in written and spoken English  Team player and well organized  Creative and able to work autonomously  Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus  More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de sécurité de cluster 80 – 100 % (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'opportunità In questo ruolo, sarai un esperto di materia riconosciuta nella sicurezza, fornendo un supporto funzionale competente in un paese o in un cluster di paesi. Sarete responsabili per la ricerca, l'analisi e l'interpretazione di minacce di sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero influenzare dipendenti, beni o operazioni. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'attuazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Segnalando al Capo della Sicurezza Regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con supervisione limitata, professionisti di livello inferiore, e contribuirai a decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti di sicurezza esperti. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Analizzare le minacce di sicurezza nazionali e internazionali emergenti e fornire valutazioni tempestive e consiglieri. - Fornire un supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza regionali e i KPI. - Assicurare la conformità attraverso audit, controlli e monitoraggio della legislazione in evoluzione della sicurezza. - Fornire consigli di gestione dei rischi di sicurezza esperti per supportare le decisioni aziendali chiave. - Miglioramento continuo e cambiamento comportamentale attraverso iniziative di sicurezza globali e regionali. - Coinvolgere gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per rafforzare la consapevolezza e le prestazioni della sicurezza. - Guidare o sostenere progetti legati alla sicurezza, gestire obiettivi, risorse e reporting. - Coordinare la resilienza organizzativa, la risposta di emergenza e la gestione delle crisi a livello nazionale. Il tuo sfondo - Min. 5 anni Istruzione avanzata e esperienza significativa come specialista di sicurezza. - Competenza comprovata nell'intelligenza delle minacce, nell'analisi dei rischi e nella gestione delle crisi. - Forte comprensione degli standard di sicurezza, della legislazione, dei requisiti di conformità e dei processi di audit. - Esperienza di coaching e consulenza leader su questioni di sicurezza all'interno di un'organizzazione complessa. - Affari fluenti in tedesco e inglese. - Capacità dimostrata di gestire i programmi di sicurezza, progetti e budget in modo efficace. - Abilitato nel coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, nella comunicazione e nella collaborazione interfunzionale. - Esperienza nella resilienza organizzativa, risposta di emergenza e coordinamento della continuità aziendale. - Capacità di operare in un ambiente di matrice globale e gestire le responsabilità in più paesi. - Approsso. 30% Viaggi richiesto Maggiori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit In dieser Rolle dienen Sie als anerkannter Fachexperte für Sicherheit und bieten kompetente funktionelle Unterstützung in einem Land oder einem Cluster von Ländern. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erforschung, Analyse und Interpretation neuer Sicherheitsbedrohungen, die Mitarbeiter, Vermögenswerte oder Operationen beeinflussen könnten. Sie werden eine wichtige Rolle bei der organisatorischen Widerstandsfähigkeit, dem Krisenmanagement und der Umsetzung der globalen und regionalen Sicherheitsstrategien von Hitachi Energy spielen. Wenn Sie sich an den Leiter der Regionalen Sicherheit melden, werden Sie komplexe Projekte mit begrenzter Aufsicht, Coach-Fachkräfte auf niedrigerer Ebene verwalten und durch erfahrene Sicherheitseinsichten zu kritischen Geschäftsentscheidungen beitragen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Analysieren Sie aufstrebende nationale und internationale Sicherheitsbedrohungen und liefern rechtzeitige Bewertungen und Berater. - Liefern Sie kompetente Sicherheitsunterstützung im ganzen Land/Kollegen, um die Angleichung an die regionalen Sicherheitsstandards und die KPIs zu gewährleisten. - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung durch Audits, Inspektionen und Überwachung der sich entwickelnden Sicherheitsgesetze. - Geben Sie Experten-Sicherheitsrisikomanagement-Beratung, um wichtige Geschäftsentscheidungen zu unterstützen. - Fahren Sie durch globale und regionale Sicherheitsinitiativen stetige Verbesserung und Verhaltensänderung. - Engagieren Sie interne und externe Akteure, um das Sicherheitsbewusstsein und die Leistung zu stärken. - Führen oder unterstützen sicherheitsrelevante Projekte, Management von Zielen, Ressourcen und Berichterstattung. - koordinierte organisatorische Widerstandsfähigkeit, Notfallreaktion und Krisenmanagement auf Länderebene. Ihr Hintergrund - Min. 5 Jahre Fortgeschrittene Ausbildung und bedeutende Erfahrung als Sicherheitsspezialist. - Bewährtes Know-how in der Bedrohungsanalyse, Risikoanalyse und Krisenmanagement. - Starkes Verständnis von Sicherheitsstandards, Rechtsvorschriften, Compliance-

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous serez un expert reconnu en matière de sécurité, fournissant un soutien fonctionnel compétent dans un pays ou un groupe de pays. Vous serez responsable de la recherche, de l'analyse et de l'interprétation des nouvelles menaces à la sécurité qui pourraient avoir des répercussions sur les employés, les biens ou les opérations. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la résilience organisationnelle, la gestion des crises et la mise en œuvre des stratégies de sécurité mondiales et régionales d'Hitachi Energy. Sous l'autorité du chef de la Sécurité régionale, vous gérerez des projets complexes avec une supervision limitée, coacherez des professionnels de niveau inférieur et contribuerez aux décisions d'affaires critiques grâce à des connaissances spécialisées en matière de sécurité. Comment vous ferez un impact - Analyser les nouvelles menaces à la sécurité nationale et internationale et fournir des évaluations et des avis en temps opportun. - Fournir un soutien de sécurité compétent dans tout le pays/groupe, en assurant l'alignement sur les normes de sécurité régionales et les ICR. - Assurer la conformité par des vérifications, des inspections et la surveillance de l'évolution de la législation en matière de sécurité. - Fournir des conseils spécialisés en gestion des risques de sécurité pour appuyer les décisions clés des entreprises. - Favoriser l'amélioration continue et le changement de comportement grâce à des initiatives de sécurité mondiales et régionales. - Mobiliser les acteurs internes et externes pour renforcer la sensibilisation à la sécurité et les performances. - Diriger ou appuyer des projets liés à la sécurité, gérer les objectifs, les ressources et les rapports. - Coordonner la résilience organisationnelle, les interventions d'urgence et la gestion des crises au niveau des pays. Vos antécédents - Moins de 5 ans Études supérieures et expérience importante en tant que spécialiste de la sécurité. - Expertise éprouvée en renseignement, analyse des risques et gestion des crises. - Une bonne compréhension des normes de sécurité, de la législation, des exigences de conformité et des processus de vérification. - Expérience de l'encadrement et des conseils aux dirigeants sur les questions de sécurité au sein d'une organisation complexe. - Les affaires parlent couramment allemand et anglais. - Capacité démontrée de gérer efficacement les programmes, les projets et les budgets de sécurité. - Compétence en engagement des intervenants, communication et collaboration interfonctionnelle. - Expérience en matière de résilience organisationnelle, d'intervention d'urgence et de coordination de la continuité des opérations. - Capacité de fonctionner dans un environnement matriciel mondial et de gérer les responsabilités dans plusieurs pays. - Env. 30% Voyage requis Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. jobs.title: IT Business Analyst
jobs.description:
The opportunity   Are you passionate about transforming manufacturing environments through smart, data‑driven digital solutions? As an IT Business Analyst for MES and Manufacturing Systems within the BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team, you will play a key role in shaping the digital backbone of our global factories. You will bridge operational needs with modern technology, enabling efficient, safe, and reliable production processes that support our Grid Integration business. You will work closely with stakeholders, development, and operations to ensure our application landscape delivers maximum business value, innovation, and user satisfaction.      This position is based in Lenzburg with the option for hybrid work. This role offers the opportunity to influence how our manufacturing sites evolve, standardize, and innovate. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your mindset and potential are equally important. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join!   How you'll make an impact   Act as the primary Business Analyst for manufacturing applications , ensuring they meet evolving operational and strategic requirements Collaborate closely with production teams, process engineers, application owners, and global GI stakeholders to collect requirements , define solutions, and secure alignment across all sites Analyze and model processes (e.g., production workflows, quality checkpoints, traceability, data collection), translating them into clear functional and technical requirements for system enhancements or new Manufacturing capabilities Support the full lifecycle of manufacturing applications, ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and integration with critical systems Facilitate workshops, perform gap analyses, lead stakeholder meetings, and create clear documentation to ensure shared understanding and effective decision‑making Identify opportunities to streamline system landscapes , improve data quality, reduce manual work, and strengthen harmonization across factories Drive continuous improvement by monitoring system performance, gathering feedback from users, and proposing enhancements to increase value and efficiency Your Background   Proven experience as an IT Business Analyst, Management Consultant, IT Consultant, or Manufacturing IT Analyst within complex industrial or production environments Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and model business and manufacturing processes and translate them into actionable requirements Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across diverse teams and cultures Demonstrate experience working with IT\/OT teams, development, operations teams and vendors to deliver high-quality application support and enhancements Experience with MES platforms, industrial data systems, or integration technologies is an advantage, but not mandatory Fluency in English is required More about us 
• We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

jobs.description:
The Opportunity Join our Local Service Center Switzerland as an intern in the Project Management team. In this role you will support project managers in Geneva while collaborating closely with colleagues in Zurich. This internship offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of a tool pool, ensuring that the necessary equipment and tools required for on-site execution are properly defined, available and maintained. You will not only define new tools, but also contribute to improving how we prepare and manage site-related resources and processes. A key part of the role includes visiting project sites to validate and understand how tools and processes are applied in practice, allowing you to directly see the impact of your work and contribute to continous improvement. How you'll make an impact    Support the setup and structuring of a tool pool for site execution (e.g., procurement, calibration tracking, and process setup) Assist in coordinating activities with internal stakeholders and external suppliers Support documentation and standardization of tool-related processes Participate in project meetings and support preparation and follow-up activities Contribute to process improvement initiatives, including mapping and optimizing project management processes Drive process improvements related to site preparation and execution efficiency Your background Ongoing studies in Engineering or a related technical field Interest in practical engineering topics, especially related to site execution, equipment, and tool handling  Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders A structured, hands-on and solution-oriented way of working as well as a proactive mindset and willingness to learn in a technical environment Interest in practical, equipment handling, site-related work and project execution Fluency in English and French; German is a strong advantage More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

Un élément clé du rôle consiste à visiter les sites de projet pour valider et comprendre comment les outils et les processus sont appliqués dans la pratique, vous permettant de voir directement l'impact de votre travail et contribuer à l'amélioration continue. jobs.title: Internship in Low-Code Development 80 - 100% (f/m(d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working  Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.

Faire des évaluations des risques, des audits et des inspections afin d'identifier les dangers et de définir des mesures d'atténuation Conduire des enquêtes sur les incidents et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et préventives efficaces Surveiller les IRC HSE, préparer des rapports et appuyer la prise de décision axée sur les données Offrir et coordonner des séances de formation sur les ITS tout en favorisant la sensibilisation et les meilleures pratiques Soutenir les audits internes, externes et de certification, en veillant à ce que des mesures de suivi opportunes Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des intervenants externes pour intégrer les IRS aux opérations quotidiennes Mener des initiatives sur les ESS et les programmes d'amélioration de l'environnement (p. ex. déchets, eau, énergie) Votre contexte Expérience minimum de 5 ans en matière d'évaluation des risques, d'analyse d'incidents et de rapports sur les performances Degré de compétence en ingénierie, en sciences de l'environnement, en santé et sécurité au travail, ou domaine similaire Certified HSE professional selon la législation suisse (obligatoire) Forte connaissance des normes ISO 14001 et ISO 45001 et de la réglementation suisse HSE Expérience éprouvée en matière d'évaluation des risques, d'.

jobs.title: Kaufmännischer Projektmanager – Transformatoren 80 – 100 % (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.   --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d)   The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Procurement Team Lead 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine dynamische und erfahrene Führungskraft für den Einkauf, die unser engagiertes Service-Team bei Hitachi, Ltd. verstärkt, wo Geschwindigkeit und Qualität von größter Bedeutung sind. In dieser Schlüsselposition führen Sie strategische Einkaufsinitiativen, optimieren die Beschaffungsprozesse und leiten ein talentiertes Team von etwa 12 Einkaufsexperten. Ihre Expertise sorgt für eine schnelle und kosteneffiziente Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen, während Sie höchste Qualitätsstandards wahren und langfristige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen zu Lieferanten fördern. Das können Sie bewirken Sie übernehmen die Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Einkaufsteams und gestalten eine leistungsorientierte sowie verantwortungsbewusste Unternehmenskultur. Sie entwickeln und implementieren innovative Beschaffungskonzepte im Einklang mit unserer Service-Strategie. Dabei legen Sie besonderen Wert auf termingerechte Lieferung, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung, Effizienzsteigerung in der Lieferkette und nachhaltige Kostenreduzierung. Die Anwendung der Critical-Path-Methode zur Sicherstellung pünktlicher Beschaffungsprozesse und zur Minimierung von Lieferverzögerungen gehört zu Ihren Kernaufgaben. Sie gewährleisten durchgängige Exzellenz im gesamten Einkaufsprozess – von der Bedarfsermittlung bis zur Zahlung – und sorgen für klare Abläufe sowie maximale Transparenz. Sie definieren und steuern die Lieferanten-Segmentierung und entwickeln zielgerichtete Beschaffungsstrategien. Zudem verantworten Sie die Auswahl, Qualifizierung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit Lieferanten. Durch den Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften auf Führungsebene und die Etablierung robuster Lieferantenmanagement-Systeme mit KPIs, Scorecards, regelmässigen Reviews und Eskalationsprozessen sichern Sie die nachhaltige Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Lieferantennetzwerks. Sie arbeiten eng mit abteilungsübergreifenden Teams wie Materialplanung, Engineering, Qualität und Controlling zusammen, um den Einkauf optimal auf die Unternehmensanforderungen abzustimmen. Sie steuern einkaufsbezogene Risiken, einschließlich Lieferkettenstörungen, Preisschwankungen und Compliance-Themen. Das bringen Sie mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Supply Chain Management, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung. Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Einkauf oder Supply Chain Management oder mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich. Nachweisbare Erfolge im strategischen Einkauf, in Verhandlungen und im Lieferanten- oder Kundenmanagement sind von Vorteil. Sehr gutes Verständnis von Einkaufsprozessen, Vertragsrecht und Prinzipien der Lieferkette. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsvermögen. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Einkauf-Software (z.B. SAP Ariba) und Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel. Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem schnelllebigen, internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten zu managen. Erfahrung in den Bereichen Fertigung, Technologie oder Industrie ist sehr wünschenswert. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungen zu optimieren und schaffen eine Umgebung, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de l'équipe d'approvisionnement 80 - 100 % (f/m/j)

descriptionByLocale.it: Possibilità Siamo alla ricerca di un esecutivo dinamico ed esperto per l'acquisto che rafforza il nostro team di assistenza dedicato a Hitachi, Ltd., dove velocità e qualità sono della massima importanza. In questa posizione chiave, conduci iniziative di acquisto strategiche, ottimizza i processi di approvvigionamento e gestisci un team di talento di circa 12 esperti di shopping. La vostra esperienza garantisce un approvvigionamento rapido e conveniente di beni e servizi, mantenendo al contempo i più elevati standard di qualità e promuovendo rapporti di partnership a lungo termine con i fornitori. Questo ti permette di assumere la leadership, la promozione e l'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro team di acquisto e creare una cultura aziendale orientata alle prestazioni e responsabile. Sviluppano e implementano concetti di approvvigionamento innovativi secondo la nostra strategia di servizio. In questo modo, ponete particolare attenzione alla consegna tempestiva, al miglioramento continuo della qualità, al miglioramento dell'efficienza della supply chain e alla riduzione dei costi sostenibile. L'applicazione del metodo Critical-Path per garantire i processi di approvvigionamento tempestivo e per ridurre al minimo i ritardi di consegna è uno dei vostri compiti principali. Garantiscono un'eccellenza costante in tutto il processo di acquisto – dalla determinazione della domanda al pagamento – e garantiscono processi chiari e massima trasparenza. Definiscono e controllano la segmentazione dei fornitori e sviluppano strategie di approvvigionamento mirate. Inoltre, sei responsabile per la selezione, la qualificazione e le trattative contrattuali con i fornitori. Con la costruzione di partnership strategiche a livello di leadership e la creazione di sistemi di gestione dei fornitori robusti con KPI, schede di punteggio, recensioni regolari e processi di escalation, è possibile garantire le prestazioni sostenibili della nostra rete di fornitori. Lavorano a stretto contatto con team interdipartimentali come la pianificazione dei materiali, l'ingegneria, la qualità e il controllo, al fine di ottimizzare l'acquisto alle esigenze aziendali. Essi controllano i rischi legati all'acquisto, tra cui interruzioni della supply chain, fluttuazioni dei prezzi e problemi di conformità. Questo ti porta a studi completi nel campo della gestione della supply chain, della gestione aziendale, dell'ingegneria o della formazione comparabile con esperienza professionale rilevante. Almeno 5 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'acquisto o nella gestione della supply chain o almeno 3 anni di esperienza di leadership in un'area collegata. I successi rilevabili nell'acquisto strategico, nei negoziati e nella gestione del fornitore o del cliente sono vantaggiosi. Ottima comprensione dei processi di acquisto, diritto contrattuale e principi della catena di fornitura. Competenze analitiche impressionate e problem-solving e decision-making. Ottima comunicazione, presentazione e competenze interpersonali. Ottima conoscenza del software di acquisto (ad esempio SAP Ariba) e Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel. Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente internazionale veloce e gestire più priorità. L'esperienza nella produzione, nella tecnologia o nell'industria è molto auspicabile. I nostri modelli di lavoro flessibili consentono di ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare e crescere. descriptionByLocale.en: The Possibility We are looking for a dynamic and experienced executive for purchasing that strengthens our dedicated service team at Hitachi, Ltd., where speed and quality are of the utmost importance. In this key position, you conduct strategic purchasing initiatives, optimize procurement processes and run a talented team of around 12 shopping experts. Your expertise ensures a fast and cost-effective procurement of goods and services while maintaining the highest quality standards and promoting long-term, partnership relationships with suppliers. This allows you to take over the leadership, promotion and further development of our purchasing team and create a performance-oriented and responsible corporate culture. They develop and implement innovative procurement concepts in accordance with our service strategy. In doing so, you place particular emphasis on timely delivery, continuous quality improvement, efficiency improvement in the supply chain and sustainable cost reduction. The application of the Critical-Path method to ensure timely procurement processes and to minimize delivery delays is one of your core tasks. They ensure consistent excellence throughout the entire purchasing process – from demand determination to payment – and ensure clear processes and maximum transparency. They define and control supplier segmentation and develop targeted procurement strategies. In addition, you are responsible for the selection, qualification and contract negotiations with suppliers. By building strategic partnerships at leadership level and establishing robust supplier management systems with KPIs, scorecards, regular reviews and escalation processes, you can ensure the sustainable performance of our supplier network. They work closely with cross-departmental teams such as material planning, engineering, quality and controlling, in order to optimally tune the purchase to the corporate requirements. They control purchase-related risks, including supply chain disruptions, price fluctuations and compliance issues. This brings you with completed studies in the field of supply chain management, business management, engineering or comparable training with relevant professional experience. At least 5 years of relevant experience in purchasing or supply chain management or at least 3 years of leadership experience in a related area. Detectable successes in strategic purchasing, in negotiations and in supplier or customer management are advantageous. Very good understanding of purchasing processes, contract law and principles of the supply chain. Impressed analytical skills as well as problem-solving and decision-making. Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Very good knowledge of purchasing software (e.g. SAP Ariba) and Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment and manage multiple priorities. Experience in manufacturing, technology or industry is very desirable. Our flexible work models help you to optimize personal and business performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow. Dans cette position clé, vous réalisez des initiatives d'achat stratégiques, optimisez les processus d'approvisionnement et dirigez une équipe talentueuse d'environ 12 experts en achats. Votre expertise assure un achat rapide et rentable de biens et de services tout en maintenant les normes de qualité les plus élevées et en favorisant des relations de partenariat à long terme avec les fournisseurs. jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   
• We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con la gestione del progetto, i clienti e i team di ingegneria multidisciplinari per definire, coordinare e fornire soluzioni di protezione robuste in linea con i requisiti di sistema, gli standard applicabili e le best practice Hitachi Energy. Potrai diventare parte di una comunità di ingegneria di livello mondiale all'interno del nostro hub europeo, lavorando insieme a colleghi altamente esperti con profonda esperienza nell'esecuzione di progetti di grandi e complessi in tutto il mondo. Questa posizione offre un ambiente eccellente per imparare, sviluppare e contribuire attivamente allo scopo di Hitachi Energy di promuovere un sistema energetico sostenibile, flessibile e sicuro. È un'occasione unica per far parte di una fase emozionante in cui l'elettricità sta diventando la spina dorsale di una società sostenibile. Come farete un impatto Piombo e possiate il campo di ingegneria di controllo e protezione nei progetti di sistema di automazione di sottostazione Definire concetti di protezione e filosofie in stretta collaborazione con l'ingegneria di piombo tecnico e con i clienti durante la fase di progettazione di base Coordinate e guidare l'ingegneria dettagliata di Protezione e controllo, garantendo l'allineamento con SCADA, il controllo delle stazioni e le discipline di sicurezza informatica Specificare, configurare e la protezione dei test La tua laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica o equivalente, con una solida esperienza nell'ingegneria della protezione per sistemi di automazione di sottostazione Prova competenza in sistemi di protezione per (sub-)sottostazioni di trasmissione Forte conoscenza di IEC 61850 e architetture di automazione di sottostazione Esperienza con Hitachi Energy Relion® protezione IEDs è un forte vantaggio Adrible per lavorare indipendentemente, prendere decisioni tecniche e gestire interfacce in progetti complessi.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Um unser Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen Senior Project Engineer mit einem starken Fokus auf Schutzsysteme für Unterstationsautomatisierungsprojekte. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie technisches Eigentum am Kontroll- und Schutzbereich in komplexen (Sub-)Transmissionsprojekten in der Schweiz und international, als zentrale technische Behörde vom Basisdesign bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Sie arbeiten eng mit Projektmanagement, Kunden und multidisziplinären Engineering-Teams zusammen, um robuste Schutzlösungen nach Systemanforderungen, anwendbaren Standards und Hitachi Energy Best Practices zu definieren, zu koordinieren und zu liefern. Sie werden Teil einer Weltklasse-Engineering-Community in unserem European Hub werden, die zusammen mit erfahrenen Kollegen mit tiefem Know-how in der Umsetzung von großen und komplexen Projekten weltweit arbeitet. Diese Position bietet ein ausgezeichnetes Umfeld, um ein nachhaltiges, flexibles und sicheres Energiesystem zu entwickeln und aktiv zu fördern. Es ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Teil einer spannenden Phase zu sein, in der Strom zum Rückgrat einer nachhaltigen Gesellschaft wird. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Lead and Own the Control & Protection Engineering-Bereich in Unterstationsautomatisierungs-System-Projekten Definieren Sie Schutzkonzepte und Philosophien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der technischen Lead Engineering und mit Kunden in der Basis-Design-Phase Koordinieren und führen Sie die Protection & Control Detail Engineering, die Ausrichtung mit SCADA, Station Control und Cyber-Sicherheitsdisziplinen Spezifizieren, konfigurieren und testen IEDs in Übereinstimmung mit Kundenanforderungen, Gittercodes, und Standards Support und Standards Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig, mit solider Erfahrung in der Protektionstechnik für Unterstationsautomatisierungssysteme Proven Know-how in Schutzsystemen für (Unter-)Übertragungsstationen Starkes Wissen über IEC 61850 und Unterstationsautomatisierungsarchitekturen Erfahrung mit Hitachi Energy Relion® Schutz IEDs ist ein starker Vorteil, um unabhängig zu arbeiten, technische Entscheidungen zu treffen und Schnittstellen in komplexen Projekten zu optimieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons un ingénieur de projet senior qui s'intéresse aux systèmes de protection pour les projets d'automatisation de sous-station. Dans ce rôle, vous prendrez la maîtrise technique du champ d'application Contrôle & Protection dans le cadre de projets (sous-)transmission complexes en Suisse et à l'échelle internationale, agissant en tant qu'autorité technique clé de la conception de base par la mise en service. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion de projet, les clients et d'ingénierie multidisciplinaire pour définir, coordonner et fournir des solutions de protection robustes en fonction des exigences du système, des normes applicables et des meilleures pratiques d'Hitachi Energy. Vous deviendrez membre d'une communauté d'ingénieurs de calibre mondial au sein de notre European Hub, travaillant aux côtés de collègues hautement expérimentés avec une expertise profonde dans la réalisation de grands et complexes projets dans le monde entier. Cette position offre un excellent environnement pour apprendre, développer et contribuer activement à l'objectif d'Hitachi Energy de faire progresser un système énergétique durable, flexible et sûr. C'est une occasion unique de participer à une phase passionnante où l'électricité devient l'épine dorsale d'une société durable. Comment faire un impact Lead et posséder le champ d'ingénierie de Contrôle & Protection dans les projets de systèmes d'automatisation de sous-station Définir des concepts et des philosophies de protection en étroite collaboration avec l'ingénierie de pointe technique et avec les clients pendant la phase de conception de base Coordonner et guider l'ingénierie détaillée de Protection & Control, en assurant l'alignement avec SCADA, le contrôle de station et les disciplines de cybersécurité Spécifiez, configurez et testez la protection des DEI conformément aux exigences du client, aux codes de grille et aux normes. Votre formation Baccalauréat en génie électrique ou équivalent, avec une solide expérience en ingénierie de protection pour les systèmes d'automatisation des sous-stations Expertise éprouvée dans les systèmes de protection pour (sous-)transmission des sous-stations Forte connaissance des architectures d'automatisation des sous-stations IEC 61850 et des architectures d'automatisation des sous-stations L'expérience avec Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs est un avantage solide Capable de travailler indépendamment, de prendre des décisions techniques et de gérer des interfaces dans des projets complexes Fortes compétences en communication et un esprit structuré et axé sur la qualité Fluent en anglais; l'allemand est un avantage En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: IT Business Intelligence Analyst 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity As a Business Intelligence Analyst within Hitachi Energy's Business Solution Team, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between complex data and strategic action for our Grid Integration business. You will be responsible for designing and delivering customer-driven BI applications that empower our HVDC and Business unit-wide teams to make informed decisions. By ensuring that our front-end solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and governed by global standards, you will contribute directly to our digital transformation journey and the ambitious goal of improving business efficiency through data transparency. How you'll make an impact Develop and maintain a roadmap for new, customer-driven BI applications, ensuring that design and report interfaces meet the specific needs of our HVDC and GI projects Ensure that all BI implementations follow the established structure and guidelines. You will drive Master Data alignment and ensure data validity through rigorous quality assurance and interface management with our data warehouse storage Actively identify and capture new Business Intelligence demands across the organization, translating business requirements into reusable data flow architectures Run BI training sessions to empower the organization, managing the application lifecycle through dedicated support, service request resolution, and the proactive use of our ticketing systems Ensure all initiatives follow PPS (Project Power System) process guidelines, contributing to a transparent and auditable environment that supports both internal goals and regulatory requirements Your background Strong experience in BI design and report development, including a deep understanding of data collection methods and interface management with data warehouse environments Proven ability to create and maintain reusable data flow architectures and ensure alignment with Master Data management principles Experience in maintaining existing BI solutions, managing application roadmaps, and utilizing ticket systems to solve service requests and issues Exceptional skills in identifying business demands and communicating technical structures to non-technical stakeholders, including conducting training sessions for diverse user groups A firm commitment to following process guidelines (such as PPS) and ensuring that local implementations adhere to global organizational structures and BI guidelines Strong focus on data quality assurance and the ability to ensure data validity across complex, large-scale IT initiatives More about us 
• We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Come Business Intelligence Analyst all'interno del Business Solution Team di Hitachi Energy, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel colmare il divario tra i dati complessi e l'azione strategica per il nostro business Grid Integration. Sarete responsabili della progettazione e della fornitura di applicazioni BI orientate al cliente che consentono ai nostri team HVDC e Business di prendere decisioni informate. Assicurando che le nostre soluzioni front-end siano scalabili, user-friendly e regolate da standard globali, contribuirai direttamente al nostro viaggio di trasformazione digitale e all'ambizioso obiettivo di migliorare l'efficienza aziendale attraverso la trasparenza dei dati. Sviluppare e mantenere una roadmap per le nuove applicazioni BI orientate al cliente, garantendo che le interfacce di progettazione e report soddisfino le specifiche esigenze dei nostri progetti HVDC e GI Assicurarsi che tutte le implementazioni BI seguano la struttura e le linee guida stabilite. Potrai guidare l'allineamento dei dati Master e garantire la validità dei dati attraverso una rigorosa garanzia della qualità e la gestione dell'interfaccia con la nostra memorizzazione del magazzino dati Identificare e catturare le nuove richieste di Business Intelligence in tutta l'organizzazione, traducendo i requisiti aziendali in architetture di flusso dati riutilizzabili Eseguire sessioni di formazione BI per potenziare l'organizzazione, gestire il ciclo di vita delle applicazioni attraverso il supporto dedicato, la risoluzione delle richieste di servizio e l'uso proattivo dei nostri sistemi di ticketing Assicurarsi che tutte le iniziative seguono obiettivi di processo PPS (Project Power System) Forte esperienza nella progettazione e nello sviluppo dei report di BI, compresa una profonda comprensione dei metodi di raccolta dei dati e della gestione delle interfacce con gli ambienti di data warehouse Prova capacità di creare e mantenere architetture di flusso dati riutilizzabili e garantire l'allineamento con i principi di gestione dei dati Master Esperienza nel mantenimento delle soluzioni BI esistenti, gestione delle roadmap delle applicazioni, e utilizzando i sistemi di ticket per risolvere le richieste dei servizi e le questioni

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit Als Business Intelligence Analyst im Business Solution Team von Hitachi Energy werden Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen komplexen Daten und strategischen Maßnahmen für unser Unternehmen Grid Integration spielen. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Gestaltung und Bereitstellung von kundengetriebenen BI-Anwendungen, die unsere HVDC- und Business-Unit-Teams befähigen, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Durch die Sicherstellung, dass unsere Frontend-Lösungen skalierbar, benutzerfreundlich und nach globalen Standards geregelt sind, tragen Sie direkt zu unserer digitalen Transformationsreise und dem ambitionierten Ziel bei, die Wirtschaftlichkeit durch Datentransparenz zu verbessern. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung einer Roadmap für neue, kundengetriebene BI-Anwendungen ausüben, um sicherzustellen, dass Design- und Report-Schnittstellen die spezifischen Bedürfnisse unserer HVDC- und GI-Projekte erfüllen. Sie werden die Ausrichtung von Master Data antreiben und die Gültigkeit der Daten durch strenge Qualitätssicherung und Schnittstellenverwaltung mit unserem Datenlagerspeicher aktiv identifizieren und erfassen neue Anforderungen von Business Intelligence in der gesamten Organisation, Übersetzen von Geschäftsanforderungen in wiederverwendbare Datenflussarchitekturen Führen Sie BI-Trainingssitzungen, um die Organisation zu befähigen, die Verwaltung des Anwendungslebenszyklus durch engagierte Unterstützung, Service-Resolution und die proaktive Nutzung unserer Ticketing-Systeme Ihr Hintergrund Starke Erfahrung in der BI-Design- und Berichtsentwicklung, einschließlich eines tiefen Verständnisses von Datenerfassungsmethoden und Schnittstellenmanagement mit Datenlagerumgebungen Bewährte Fähigkeit, wiederverwendbare Datenfluss-Architekturen zu erstellen und zu pflegen und sicherzustellen, Anpassung an Master Data Management-Prinzipien Erfahrung bei der Aufrechterhaltung bestehender BI-Lösungen, Verwaltung von Anwendungs-Roadmaps und Nutzung von Ticket-Systemen zur Lösung von Service-Anforderungen Außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten bei der Ermittlung von Geschäftsanforderungen und -Anforderungen

Je nach Erfahrung und Rolle kann dies beinhalten: Pensions- und Versicherungspläne Performancebasierter Bonus Flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité En tant qu'analyste de l'intelligence d'affaires au sein de l'équipe de solutions d'affaires d'Hitachi Energy, vous jouerez un rôle central pour combler l'écart entre les données complexes et l'action stratégique pour notre activité d'intégration du réseau. Vous serez responsable de la conception et de la livraison d'applications BI axées sur le client qui permettent à nos équipes HVDC et Business de prendre des décisions éclairées. En s'assurant que nos solutions front-end sont évolutives, conviviales et régies par des normes mondiales, vous contribuerez directement à notre parcours de transformation numérique et à l'objectif ambitieux d'améliorer l'efficacité des entreprises grâce à la transparence des données. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Élaborer et maintenir une feuille de route pour les nouvelles applications BI axées sur le client, en veillant à ce que la conception et les interfaces de rapport répondent aux besoins spécifiques de nos projets HVDC et GI. Vous piloterez l'alignement de Master Data et assurerez la validité des données grâce à une assurance de qualité rigoureuse et à une gestion de l'interface avec notre entrepôt de données.Identifiez et saisissez activement les nouvelles demandes de Business Intelligence dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, traduisez les exigences opérationnelles en architectures réutilisables de flux de données. Exécutez des séances de formation BI pour autonomiser l'organisation, gérer le cycle de vie de l'application grâce à un soutien dédié, à la résolution des demandes de service et à l'utilisation proactive de nos systèmes de billetterie. Votre expérience Forte expérience dans la conception et l'élaboration de rapports BI, y compris une compréhension approfondie des méthodes de collecte de données et de la gestion des interfaces avec les environnements d'entrepôt de données Capacité éprouvée de créer et de maintenir des architectures de flux de données réutilisables et d'assurer l'alignement avec les principes de gestion des données de base Expérience dans le maintien des solutions BI existantes, la gestion des feuilles de route des applications et l'utilisation des systèmes de tickets pour résoudre les demandes et les problèmes de service Compétences exceptionnelles dans l'identification des demandes d'affaires et la communication des structures techniques aux intervenants non techniques, y compris la tenue de séances de formation pour divers groupes d'utilisateurs Un engagement ferme à suivre les lignes directrices du processus (comme les SP) et à veiller à ce que les mises en oeuvre locales respectent les structures organisationnelles mondiales et les lignes directrices BI.
• Nous offrons un package d'avantages concurrentiel suisse conçu pour soutenir votre croissance professionnelle et votre bien-être. Selon l'expérience et le rôle, cela peut comprendre : Régimes de retraite et d'assurance Prime au rendement Modalités de travail flexibles Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement

jobs.title: Transport, Trade & Logistics Junior Specialist Export 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern   Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. jobs.title: R&D Power Semiconductor Chip Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

jobs.title: Internship Production Development 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and private transportation more energy-efficient, while our technology also enables the production and transportation of renewable energy from the production site to the consumer. A new production facility is being established in Prague for one of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) products. This move is motivated by considerations of capacity and business continuity. As part of your Internship in Production Development, you will assist with the transfer of production capabilities from Lenzburg to Prague. You play a vital role in facilitating the introduction and ramp-up of Hitachi Energy Semiconductors products at our second manufacturing site in Prague \/ Czech Republic. 
• Your responsibilities focus on ensuring operational excellence, process integrity, and effective knowledge transfer across locations. How you'll make an impact Supporting the implementation and qualification of new production tools, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards Assisting with equipment integration as well as the collection and analysis of production and process data Establishing process quality control procedures and corresponding control loops to maintain product consistency and compliance Organizing and supporting training of new production personnel, ensuring effective knowledge transfer from the Lenzburg site to the new factory Supporting product qualification by coordinating production of samples and testing activities Support the implementation of logistical flows for raw materials and processed parts between Lenzburg and Prague Ensuring comprehensive and accurate documentation of processes, work instructions, supporting materials, production tools, and their configurations, to support operational excellence and future audits Your background Study engineering, physics, chemistry, production technology, or related disciplines; holding a bachelor's degree is preferred. The assignment can be part of a master's thesis Show genuine interest in semiconductor backend manufacturing, including areas like innovative processes, logistics, and governance Show effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, as well as an interest in international collaboration and knowledge sharing Exhibit attention to detail in documentation and process setup, along with organizational abilities for supporting training, planning, and knowledge transfer Adapt easily to changing environments, embrace new tools, and commit to a six- to nine-month assignment split between Switzerland and the Czech Republic, supporting both operational and developmental activities English at minimum C1 level. Mastering of German is an advantage More about us This internship provides hands-on experience with manufacturing processes and operational excellence in a leading power semiconductor environment. It offers the chance to develop technical and organizational skills while supporting a major industrial expansion across Switzerland and the Czech Republic.
